deltas.oldValue: The historical evidence incorrectly stated that the live Sync Backup family had been withdrawn.
deltas.newValue: Page/Sync Backup remains a live Phone/Tablet canonical Component Set, backed by the shared Surface/Sync Backup component graph.

deltas.oldValue: The Phone backup history contained four non-chronological cards.
deltas.newValue: The Phone Backup/History List contains one descending list: 2026-06-21, 2026-06-20, 2026-06-16, 2026-06-12 and 2026-06-06, followed by one Expand action.

deltas.oldValue: The Tablet backup history contained the same four non-chronological cards.
deltas.newValue: The Tablet Backup/History List inherits the same five-card descending structure and one Expand action.

deltas.oldValue: The Phone prototype carried six loosely aligned restore hit areas after the list was reduced to five cards.
deltas.newValue: Five transparent restore hit areas align one-for-one with the canonical Phone backup cards; the obsolete sixth hit area is deleted.

deltas.oldValue: The Tablet prototype carried six loosely aligned restore hit areas after the list was reduced to five cards.
deltas.newValue: Five transparent restore hit areas align one-for-one with the canonical Tablet backup cards; the obsolete sixth hit area is deleted.

deltas.oldValue: The shared Loading status panel exposed a visible but noninteractive Cancel label.
deltas.newValue: The loading panel contains only the loading icon, title and body, matching the requested confirm → loading → complete flow.

prototype.restoreEntry: Each of the five Phone and five Tablet backup-card hit areas opens Overlay/Restore Backup/Confirm (2564:36726) with a 0.15s dissolve overlay.
prototype.confirm: Confirm (2564:36753) swaps to Overlay/Restore Backup/Loading (2564:36734) with a 0.15s dissolve.
prototype.settle: Loading changes to Overlay/Restore Backup/Complete (2564:36745) after 1.2s; Complete closes after 1.5s.
prototype.exception: Restore entry hit areas live in the explicit Phone/Tablet prototype wrappers because the scrolling page-instance consumer needs a direct prototype overlay target. They are aligned with, and traceable to, the five canonical list cards; no Restore Preview page is reintroduced.

boundary: This re-enables the replaced WebDAV/Sync Backup design without restoring the deleted Restore Preview page, inventing new configuration modules, changing UiEvent/state ownership, or touching non-sync page families.
